svg.aria-label: The shape shared by every act one system: a browser talking to an API, the API owning a store, and one call out to a service you do not control. A request travels browser to API to store and back. The outside call is marked in a warm colour as the part that will be slow, hostile or absent.
svg.text: EVERY ONE OF THE FIVE IS THIS SHAPE
